invariants.description: vesicle conservation: V_Ca + V_1Ca + ... + V_5Ca stays at its initial total 1 (every binding/unbinding term of Eqs. 108-113 cancels in the sum, with the Eq. 109 b^0 fix and V_5Ca in Eq. 112)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((V_Ca + V_1Ca + V_2Ca + V_3Ca + V_4Ca + V_5Ca) - (V_Ca + V_1Ca + V_2Ca + V_3Ca + V_4Ca + V_5Ca)[0])) <= 1e-9

invariants.description: values within bounds: every vesicle fraction stays in [0, 1]; Cai and NE stay non-negative (i_Ca <= 0)
invariants.expr: np.all(np.vstack([V_Ca, V_1Ca, V_2Ca, V_3Ca, V_4Ca, V_5Ca]) >= -1e-9) & np.all(np.vstack([V_Ca, V_1Ca, V_2Ca, V_3Ca, V_4Ca, V_5Ca]) <= 1 + 1e-9) & np.all(Cai >= -1e-12) & np.all(NE >= -1e-15)

invariants.description: Ca step (i_Ca stepped from 0 to its run value at t = 0, Cai from 0): Cai follows its exact solution Cai(t) = -i_Ca 1e-6/(2 F V_Z K_Ca) (1 - exp(-K_Ca t)) (i_Ca in nA: 1e-9 A/nA x 1e3 mmol/mol)

Ca step, release exercised: at the end of the run (Cai at its plateau) the vesicle states are at the detailed-balance equilibrium of the 5-site scheme, V_5Ca = x^5 b^-10 / sum_k C(5,k) x^k b^-k(k-1)/2 with x = K_on Cai/K_off, and V_5Ca > 0.5 at the run's ~0.1 mM plateau
Ca step, NE release: E = gamma V_5Ca and the cleft NE is at its quasi-steady state n a E 1e3/(N_A V_cleft P_up) (NET clearance P_up = 1e7 /s is much faster than the vesicle kinetics), and NE > 0
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(E - gamma*V_5Ca)) <= 1e-9*gamma and abs(NE[-1] - n*a*E[-1]*1e3/(6.02214076e23*V_cleft*P_up)) <= 1e-4*NE[-1] and NE[-1] > 0

bc_sweep.rationale: i_Ca is swept from 0 (no Ca entry) to -0.01 nA (active-zone Ca plateau ~0.5 mM with K_Ca 1000 /s); the run's -0.002 nA gives a ~0.1 mM plateau, the peak active-zone Ca Tao 2011 cites for exocytosis. Outward i_Ca (> 0) would drive Cai negative, so it is bounded to <= 0; b is a cooperativity factor in [0, 1].

baseline.reason: candidate: none in Tao 2011 for this component alone (NE release is reported only as the WKY/SHR ratio of stimulation-evoked release, main text p. 597-598); a validation needs the varicosity Ca current and K_Ca (unsourced).

calibrate.note: not_applicable: no data instance yet; K_Ca would be the parameter to calibrate.
